item.title: Feeding rates in sessile versus motile ciliates are hydrodynamically equivalent
item.description: Motility endows microorganisms with the ability to swim to nutrient-rich environments, but many species are sessile. item.description: Functional MRI (fMRI) research has traditionally investigated task processing using static blocked or event-related designs. item.description: Elevated levels of the gut microbe-derived metabolite trimethylamine N-oxide (TMAO) are associated with cardiometabolic disease risk. item.description: Natural populations are often spatially structured, meaning they exist as metapopulations composed of subpopulations connected by migration. item.description: Adaptive goal-directed behavior requires dynamic coordination of movement, motivation, and environmental cues. Among these, cautious actions, where animals adjust their behavior in anticipation of predictable threats, are essential for survival.
